snippet.title: FULL REPLAY (English) : NorthEast United FC vs Bengaluru FC (1-1) | MG ISL 2026-27
snippet.description:
#MGISLonYT || NorthEast United FC vs Bengaluru FC || Match Content || Full Match Replay || Match 19 || 30-Oct-2026 || English || #ytindia 

Bengaluru FC snatched a late point in Guwahati, as Vinith Venkatesh’s stoppage-time equaliser earned them a 1-1 draw against NorthEast United FC! Jithin M.S. gave the league leaders the lead in the 15th minute, finishing off Ethyan González’s pass. Bengaluru had 64% of the ball and took 18 shots, but NorthEast held on until the third minute of stoppage time. Then Vinith made the most of a Gurmeet Singh error and equalised from Sunil Chhetri’s pass. Both sides stay unbeaten. NorthEast United are top of the table on eight points, and Bengaluru are one behind on seven. 
Match highlight: Sunil Chhetri came up with the assist for the late equaliser. It’s also the second 1-1 in a row between these two sides, after their meeting in Bengaluru in February finished level too.

Goals: NEUFC: Jithin M.S. (15’) | BFC: Vinith Venkatesh (90+3’)


Up next: Churchill Brothers SC vs NorthEast United FC on 5 November, followed by FC Goa vs Bengaluru FC on 6 November. Kick-off times are 5:00 PM IST and 7:30 PM IST.

snippet.description:
#MGISLonYT || Mohun Bagan Super Giant vs Punjab FC || LIVE || Match 21 || 31-Oct-2026 || Hindi || #YTIndia

मोहन बागान सुपर जायंट शनिवार रात VYBK में MG ISL 2026-27 के गेमवीक 4 में पंजाब FC की मेज़बानी करेगी, और हाल के इतिहास को देखें तो आखिरी सीटी तक नज़रें हटाना मुश्किल होगा।

पिछले सीज़न कोलकाता में यह मुकाबला पाँच गोल वाला रोमांचक मैच रहा था। पंजाब ने दो बार बढ़त बनाई, लेकिन स्टॉपेज टाइम में जेसन कमिंग्स की फ़्री-किक ने मरीनर्स को 3-2 से जीत दिला दी। इस सीज़न देर से गोल करना पंजाब की पहचान बन गया है। राफ़ाएल मेस्सी बौली ने ओडिशा FC के खिलाफ स्टॉपेज टाइम में विजयी गोल किया, गुरकीरत सिंह ने मुंबई सिटी के खिलाफ 90वें मिनट में बराबरी दिलाई, और पिछले हफ़्ते 19 साल के सनाथोई सिंह ने आखिरी पलों में गोल दागकर चर्चिल ब्रदर्स SC को 3-2 से हराया। इसके साथ शेर्स सात अंकों के साथ अब तक अजेय हैं। मोहन बागान को गुवाहाटी में पहले मैच में हार मिली थी, लेकिन उसके बाद टीम ने दोनों मैच जीते हैं। पहले दूसरे हाफ में ली एर्विन और मिगेल फ़िगेरा के गोल से स्पोर्टिंग क्लब दिल्ली को 2-1 से हराया और फिर सोमवार को 85वें मिनट में मनवीर सिंह के गोल से चेन्नईयिन FC को 1-0 से मात दी। मरीनर्स अब पंजाब से सिर्फ़ एक अंक पीछे हैं, और यहाँ जीत उन्हें मेहमान टीम से आगे पहुँचा देगी।

Mohun Bagan Super Giant welcome Punjab FC to the VYBK on Saturday night for Gameweek 4 of the MG ISL 2026-27. If recent history is anything to go by, nobody should switch off before the final whistle.

Last season's meeting in Kolkata was a five-goal thriller in which Punjab led twice before Jason Cummings curled in a stoppage-time free kick to win it 3-2 for the Mariners. Late goals have become Punjab's thing this season too. Raphaël Messi Bouli won it in stoppage time against Odisha FC, Gurkirat Singh equalised in the 90th minute against Mumbai City, and 19-year-old Sanathoi Singh struck at the death to beat Churchill Brothers SC 3-2 last weekend, leaving the Shers unbeaten with seven points. Mohun Bagan lost their opener in Guwahati but have won both games since, beating Sporting Club Delhi 2-1 with second-half goals from Lee Erwin and Miguel Figueira and then edging Chennaiyin FC 1-0 on Monday through Manvir Singh's 85th-minute goal. That leaves the Mariners one point behind Punjab, and a win here would take them past their visitors.

snippet.title: LIVE: Chennaiyin FC vs Kerala Blasters FC | MG ISL 2026-27 | Gameweek 4
snippet.description:
#MGISLonYT || Chennaiyin FC vs Kerala Blasters FC || LIVE || Match 20 || 31-Oct-2026 || English || #YTIndia

The southern derby comes to the Marina Arena on Saturday evening, as Chennaiyin FC host Kerala Blasters FC in Gameweek 4 of the MG ISL 2026-27.

Chennaiyin won the last meeting between these rivals in Kochi, where Imran Khan's curling shot three minutes before half-time gave the Marina Machans a 1-0 win, their first of last season and their first in Kochi in six years. This season they opened with a 1-1 draw at FC Goa, where Irfan Yadwad scored first, before losing 2-0 in Bengaluru. On Monday in Kolkata they created plenty of chances but were punished by Manvir Singh's 85th-minute goal in a 1-0 defeat to Mohun Bagan, so they are still waiting for their first win. The Blasters have had a mixed start, with a 2-0 win over Inter Kashi followed by a 4-1 defeat in Guwahati. Last weekend they were held 0-0 by Mumbai City in Kochi, where Amrinder Singh made the key saves and Mohammed Sanan was a constant threat down the flank. Both sides will see this derby as the chance to get their season going properly.
